note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성(2026-10-25 추가). {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a lively night market street lined with food stalls under strings of warm lights
feature_en: wooden food stalls with red awnings and steaming metal pots
strings of round yellow bulbs hanging across the street
ground_en: a paved street lit in patches of warm yellow
gray paving stones worn smooth by many footsteps
far_en: the street running away between two rows of lit stalls
a crowd of small figures far down the street

밤.sky_en: a black night sky above the string lights
밤.light_en: warm yellow light from the hanging bulbs comes from above and in front of {o}, falling on {p} face and shoulders
밤.shadow_en: soft shadows gather behind {o} between the stalls
밤.desc_ko: 맑은 밤, 머리 위 앞쪽 노란 전구들이 비춤

초저녁.sky_en: a deep blue sky above the first lit bulbs
초저녁.light_en: warm bulb light comes from the stall on the camera's left, lighting {p} face and shoulders, with cool blue evening light on the right

초저녁.desc_ko: 초저녁, 왼쪽 가판의 따뜻한 전구빛과 오른쪽의 푸른 저녁빛

한밤 파장.sky_en: a black night sky above the thinning string lights

간식 들고 걷기.desc_ko: 종이컵 떡볶이를 들고 길을 걸으며 카메라를 보고 웃음

가판 앞에 서기.pose_en: stands in front of a food stall with one hand resting on the wooden counter
